<!-- pr-reviewer: b8653f25ef651bb5d00c6dd40a3e3758c2e21a80 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (after the parent #1522, see notes).

Reviewed at the high tier (safety floor: it changes what the gouge verdict judges and what a Slot may cut). No earlier collaborator review marker exists on this PR.

**What looks good**
- `depth_law_of` (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`, the new `OpParams::Slot { .. } => DepthLaw::Section` arm) only ADDS a judgement: a Slot on a part-solid source (picked or whole part) is now checked by the section law. The `!part_solid` early return is untouched, so a Stock source is cut as before. Nothing that was refused before can post now, and the judged material is not narrowed.
- The confine law (`SlotBound`, `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room.rs`) refuses by name a slot too wide, too long or placed outside its picked room; it runs at generation (`generate.rs` Slot arm) and in the preview (`material_source.rs`), so the outline is never drawn across a wall. Degenerate input (non-finite points, edges under two points, zero-length or parallel-less edges, patch/vertex picks) returns a named `GenError::Invalid`. The indexing in `from_edges` is guarded by the length check above it; no unwrap/expect/panic on the user path.
- No new command: the seeding rides the existing `CreateOperation` and `SetOperationGeometry`, validated at creation and inside the same command, so one undo takes back pick and seed (`prev`/`next` restore both). Invalid picks seed nothing and generation names why. No new MCP tool is needed, MCP calls those same commands.
- Tests live in the owning crates: motion `slot_room_tests.rs`, app `tests/slot_picks.rs` (uses app commands and world), ui `slot_pick_page_tests.rs`. The changed pin is explained and its old assertion was the unsafe behaviour; the mutation check in the body is plausible and consistent with the arm.
- Provenance lines present, decision records for both issues, no snapshot PNG, golden, dependency or process-file change. New files are under ~400 lines (`slot_room.rs` 369).

**Results merged with main** (on the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43515565509, main d00243a5)
- Trial merge with main: clean. Quick gate on the merged tree: motion suites ok (186 s), app suites ok (676 s), ui suites ok (68 s), 0 failed. Clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run locally: no `cfg(windows)` or per-OS line in the diff.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. Stacked on #1522 (its head has moved to 8f6e00b3 since this branch was cut from f35bd14e). Merge #1522 first and check the merge-time refresh is a clean merge; if #1522 changed again in `depth_law_of`'s Slot arm, a re-read of that one arm is worth it.
2. `CreateOperation` replaces typed endpoints/width with the picked room when a Slot is created on picks (`create.rs`); it is documented in the decision file, but a user who typed numbers and then picks edges loses them silently (undo restores). Fine as designed.
3. Circular still has the same gap (#1543, filed by the author).
4. `generate.rs` is far over 400 lines already (3.4k); this PR adds about 18 lines, not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
